rv.q: Though I suspect this production may not survive Hart's departure on September 17, there is definitely more to it than celebrity casting.
This production, fluently directed by Nikolai Foster, also has the benefit of a kind of rough theatrical magic.
I found the current revival of Annie at the Piccadilly Theatre weak for a number of reasons.

cn.t: Critics praise this heartfelt revival of the classic musical, with Nikolai Foster's direction earning particular acclaim for its sincerity and theatrical magic that perfectly suits the intimate Piccadilly Theatre.
